commands.notes: Template-free creation from the theme. -Password is SecureString; its transformation also accepts a plain string (with a warning) or a PSCredential. The designer-deck engine renders every slide, so deck-plan options live here. Outline route: a Markdown outline becomes a deck through Convert-OfficeDocument -Path .\Review.md -To PowerPoint (headings/--- start slides, lists become PowerPointList, tables/images flow, blockquotes become notes); nothing in this area maps to it. -Theme is the one user-facing design choice; -Style (renamed from -Direction) is optional designer-engine tuning layered on it. The Boardroom creative direction is selected by -Theme Boardroom, so PowerPointDeckStyle has no Boardroom value: Auto, FieldProof, EditorialCaseStudy, TechnicalMap, QuietAppendix.

commands.name: New-OfficePowerPointPdfOptions
commands.synopsis: Creates PowerPoint-to-PDF settings for Convert-OfficeDocument -To Pdf -Options.
commands.notes: Include* switches whose library default is on become No*.

examples.title: Export notes pages to PDF
examples.description: Creates options that print each slide with its speaker notes and converts the deck.
examples.code:
$options = New-OfficePowerPointPdfOptions -PageLayout NotesPages
Convert-OfficeDocument -Path .\Reports\Q3-Review.pptx -To Pdf -OutputPath .\Reports\Q3-Review-Notes.pdf -Options $options

examples.title: Print handouts for a workshop
examples.description: Converts every workshop deck to three-slides-per-page handouts without speaker notes.
examples.code:
$options = New-OfficePowerPointPdfOptions -PageLayout Handouts -HandoutSlidesPerPage 3 -NoSpeakerNotes
Get-ChildItem -Path .\Workshop -Filter *.pptx | Convert-OfficeDocument -To Pdf -OutputDirectory .\Workshop\Handouts -Options $options

commands.name: New-OfficePowerPointImageOptions
commands.synopsis: Creates slide rendering settings for Export-OfficeDocumentImage and ConvertTo-OfficeDocumentImage -Options.
commands.notes: Slide selection, scale, background color and resolution are -Page, -Scale, -BackgroundColor and -Dpi on Export-OfficeDocumentImage and ConvertTo-OfficeDocumentImage, so this factory does not repeat them. The remaining common image-option parameters come from the shared image-options base used by every New-Office*ImageOptions command; keep them identical across formats.

examples.title: Render selected slides without backgrounds
examples.description: Export-OfficeDocumentImage selects slides 1 and 2; the options leave out the slide backgrounds.
examples.code:
$options = New-OfficePowerPointImageOptions -NoSlideBackground
Export-OfficeDocumentImage -Path .\Reports\Q3-Review.pptx -Page 1-2 -OutputDirectory .\Reports\Images -Options $options

examples.title: Make intranet thumbnails
examples.description: Caps every slide image at 1280 pixels wide on a white background, including hidden appendix slides.
examples.code:
$options = New-OfficePowerPointImageOptions -MaximumOutputWidth 1280 -IncludeHiddenSlides
Export-OfficeDocumentImage -Path .\Reports\All-Hands.pptx -OutputDirectory .\Intranet\All-Hands -Format Png -BackgroundColor White -Options $options

commands.name: New-OfficePowerPointOpenDocumentOptions
commands.synopsis: Creates PowerPoint-to-ODP settings for Convert-OfficeDocument -To OpenDocument -Options.

examples.title: Convert to ODP without speaker notes
examples.description: Creates options that leave out notes and converts the deck to OpenDocument.
examples.code:
$options = New-OfficePowerPointOpenDocumentOptions -NoSpeakerNotes
Convert-OfficeDocument -Path .\Reports\Q3-Review.pptx -To OpenDocument -OutputPath .\Reports\Q3-Review.odp -Options $options

examples.title: Archive decks only when nothing is lost
examples.description: Converts a folder of decks to ODP for the archive and stops on any deck whose conversion would drop content.
examples.code:
$options = New-OfficePowerPointOpenDocumentOptions -LossPolicy Block
Get-ChildItem -Path .\Archive\2025 -Filter *.pptx | Convert-OfficeDocument -To OpenDocument -OutputDirectory .\Archive\2025-Odp -Options $options -NoClobber

examples.title: Publish a deck as HTML
examples.description: Converts a deck to a themed HTML page.
examples.code: Convert-OfficeDocument -Path .\Reports\Q3-Review.pptx -To Html -OutputPath .\Site\q3-review.html -Options (New-OfficePowerPointHtmlOptions -Theme Modern)

examples.title: Publish training decks to the intranet
examples.description: Converts each training deck to semantic HTML slides without speaker notes, ready for the intranet search index.

$options = New-OfficePowerPointHtmlOptions -Profile SemanticSlides -Theme Modern -NoNotes
Get-ChildItem -Path .\Training -Filter *.pptx | Convert-OfficeDocument -To Html -OutputDirectory .\Intranet\Training -Options $options
